newsitem.title: USA: U S West Media customer base rises.
newsitem.headline: U S West Media customer base rises.

text.p: U S West Media Group said on Friday its customer base grew 17 percent to 6.5 million worldwide in the third quarter.
It also said third-quarter operating cash flow rose 22 percent over the year-earlier period, excluding the effects of a one-time charge of $35 million to streamline operations.
MediaOne, the company's Atlanta cable television operation, had a six percent increase in subscribers to 511,000 and an 11 percent rise in revenues to $60 million.
Media Group's investment in Time Warner Inc's Time Warner Entertainment, generated operating cash flow of $151 million, up 12 percent from the year-earlier third quarter.
Operating cash flow for the company's domestic cellular operations rose 48 percent to $113 million and the subscriber base rose 43 percent to 1.7 million customers.
Revenues for U S West direct, the directory service, rose four percent to $274 million in the third quarter.
